scope: Saved results plus a single exact-ID catalog TSV read for one stereo case; no new candidate generation, forward model, 3D or qualification.

method.gate_order: Saved accept callback records the first thrown gate per observed distinct product. The categories group exact saved rejection strings; no gates were rerun.
method.nearest_path: Only the first of up to five saved anchor-passed rejected products ranked by original-hit bit Tanimoto is quoted per input. Anchor-failed products have no saved nodes in this result.
method.plan_lookup: New catalog role checks, not pool_queries or cached blocks, indicate fresh candidate screening; zero role checks does not prove no usable stock.
method.source_stereo: Saved rejected-route leaf nodes contain building_block_id hashes without leaf SMILES or atom-level provenance.

next_work_hypotheses.proposal: Bound a first catalog-query sweep per prepared outer plan (with unchanged global and per-query ceilings), then redistribute unused rows; retain exact accounting and cached-query semantics.
next_work_hypotheses.confirmed_basis: Several v10 plans with selected inner rules received zero fresh role checks while the global catalog-row limit was reached.
next_work_hypotheses.hypothesis: A fair initial row allocation may expose route candidates in later plans; saved data do not establish their stock availability or gate passage.

next_work_hypotheses.proposal: Save leaf SMILES/atom stereo provenance and gate outcomes for bounded rejected route graphs, then investigate generic retention of specified source stereo and avoidance of newly unspecified centers under unchanged gates.
next_work_hypotheses.confirmed_basis: Four uncovered inputs have zero anchor-passed products, and saved building-block IDs alone cannot identify the source of an unspecified sulfur center in a representative rejected product.
next_work_hypotheses.hypothesis: Better provenance may reveal a narrow search or reaction-center correction; no automatic stereo assignment is justified by current records.

representative_stereo_source.scope: One saved rejected route and two exact catalog IDs. One read-only TSV byte stream, no Catalog constructor/index, generation or model. RDKit applied only to three recorded SMILES.

saved_route.first_gate_failure: 3D scoring requires specified stereochemistry; enumerate stereoisomers explicitly

finding.interpretation: The unassigned sulfur stereocenter already occurs in catalog leaf ob0, while leaf ob1 carries the assigned carbon stereocenter. The product also has an unassigned sulfur center. This is a source-level observation, not a proof of atom-by-atom transfer.

representative_stereo_source.limit: Saved rejected-route nodes contain no atom-mapped forward witness or leaf-to-product atom correspondence. The report cannot formally assign the product sulfur atom to ob0 by an audited atom mapping; it only establishes that unspecified S is present before the reaction in ob0. No inference of catalog absence or synthetic impossibility is made.

limitations: First failure categories are not an independent assessment of every gate.
No anchor-passed products does not prove synthesis impossible.
The source-level unspecified sulfur observation lacks an audited leaf-to-product atom mapping.
Fair first-query quotas and stereo-aware selection remain untested proposals; frozen quality gates and work caps remain unchanged.
